results.title: Qashmou
results.overview: Qashmou’, a young man from a humble Saudi neighbourhood, constantly stirs up trouble, dragging others into it. But everything changes for him—and for those around him—when he moves to Riyadh to work for a wealthy family.

results.title: Homeys
results.overview: Set against the backdrop of Hollywood, Homeys follows four unhoused artists in Los Angeles fighting to survive while chasing their creative dreams.

results.title: A Price We Have To Pay
results.original_title: A Price We Have To Pay
results.overview: Ignacio Ezcurra, the only Argentinian journalist sent to Vietnam in 1968, vanished in the most documented war, leaving behind a single haunting photograph of his lifeless body in the streets of Saigon. The mystery of his death was left unchallenged for decades. Until now.

results.title: The Projectionist
results.overview: In a forgotten theater, a haunted man's past flickers back to life-forcing a final reckoning.

results.title: Fernherrlichkeit
results.overview: Two students get closer to each other in a time, that does not intend this. Will the one be able to leave the ruins of his past behind and follow the call of the other?

results.title: Crescendo
results.overview: In the ruins of a Roman amphitheatre in the South of France, the cast and crew of an ambitious staging of The Marriage of Figaro is thrown off balance when troubling accusations threaten to derail the entire production.  As tensions intensify, loyalties slowly fracture and deep generational disagreement emerges, throwing their sheltered opera world into a great divide.

results.title: Kenny Loggins: Conviction of the Heart
results.original_title: Kenny Loggins: Conviction of the Heart
results.overview: Everybody cut footloose! From chart-topping anthems to movie soundtracks, multi-award-winning singer songwriter Kenny Loggins reflects on a career that defined a generation, tracing his life on and off stage across decades of reinvention.

results.title: Melodrama
results.overview: After her husband’s death, Sonia is forced to shrink her life, trading her sprawling family home for a cramped, unfamiliar apartment. In this state of displacement, her world is a quiet hum of grief and rigid routines, until she hears the rhythm of a neighboring construction site. There she meets Aimé, a Haitian worker whose presence awakens a dormant yet intense desire. Their connection is swift and tender, yet their romance exists in a crossfire.

results.title: Saturday Night's Main Event: January 24, 2026
results.overview: A Fatal 4-Way Match in Montreal determines the No. 1 contender to the Undisputed WWE Championship; RHIYO defend the WWE Women's Tag Team Title.

results.title: Node
results.overview: A poignant exploration of childhood illness, resilience, and family.

results.title: Closing Night
results.overview: A celebrated actress's life begins to unravel on the eve of her greatest performance. When her sister April arrives in New York after a 30-year estrangement, the stage is set for a tense family confrontation.

results.title: Queen Concerto 4
results.original_title: 嬢王協奏曲4 甘美なる遊戯は終わらない
results.overview: Fuka, a top hostess who has lost sight of her own goals despite being a descendant of Ichijo Shino, the legendary "Queen" of the neon-lit district, encounters Ranmaru, a former host who once handled rough work under Shino. Enthralled by Ranmaru's strength fueled by revenge and ambition, Fuka rebels against her mother and Jin, the current "Night King" who is allied with her. However, the dark flames burning within Ranmaru's heart begin to engulf the entire neon district, drawing in Meg, one of Jin's biggest customers, and Yuka, a former hostess on the run after a shooting incident... (Story continues in "Queen of the Night vs. Night King 2")

results.title: Please
results.overview: PLEASE is a dark comedy about humankind’s desire to love and be loved. An animated short centred around neediness, intimacy and romance. In a world that preaches self-control, the film explores the vulnerable sides of ourselves we try to hide.

results.overview: All 10 bands perform in a joint concert, held in commemoration of the franchise's 10th anniversary on February 28, 2026, at K Arena Yokohama.

results.title: Justino - Behind the Kingdom
results.overview: In the outskirts of Rio de Janeiro during the early 1980s, Justino finds a chance to escape poverty and transform his life through a powerful neo-Pentecostal church. Beneath his rapid rise and success as a pastor lie repressed desires, secrets, ambition, and betrayal. Fifteen years later, he seeks to settle the score with his past.
